shared_elements: figure holding/wielding object(s) in outstretched hand
justification: The only real correspondence is a single standing frontal human figure occupying the upper-central field and holding objects in its extended arms, which is about as generic as anthropomorphic imagery gets. Everything else differs: A is a dense, elaborately detailed drawing of one richly costumed figure with headdress, beaded ornaments, garments and staff filling the whole surface, while B is a sparse schematic composition of a thin stick-limbed figure plus a separate quadruped and a crewed boat with a row of vertical strokes, rendered as plain thick outlines with no ornament.
